text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I screwed up, right at the very end.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
And yet so far. If I'm not number one,
what's the
point?
choice_data_list: We were just one step away.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I need to get back to training and start
over from
the top! I have to get even
stronger...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: No, I will get even stronger!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way home...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yo.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Well, well. Look who it is.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
How come you're back in Japan so soon?
Don't
tell me you lost and ran back
home with your tail
between your legs?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You wish. I'm heading back out
sometime this
year. But before I do...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
We need to settle things once and for
all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Once and for all, huh?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the Queen Elizabeth II Cup,
all I can
think about is... how much I
wanna beat you.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I can leave things as they
are after
seeing how cool you were.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: What, that's it? That's what you came back for?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Fine. I'll take you up on that challenge.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I've also been doing some thinking ever
since the
Derby—about how much I want
to beat you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I can tell you're not going to just let me have the number one title—but I'm not letting you take it either.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Would ya look at that? You sound
just like
me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: No, you're the one who's acting like me!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
We'll settle this at the autumn Tenno
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The autumn Tenno Sho is quite
prestigious even
among the G1 races. It
represents one of the
highest honors an
Umamusume in her senior year
can win.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: And it's the chance of a lifetime, too.
choice_data_list: Win, and you'll get plenty of attention.
Win, and you'll get plenty of attention.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Okay. I'll take part. But don't complain
when I
blow right past you, Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It's time to see who comes out on top.
Who's
really number one.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Sure. But let me tell you one thing: I
won't lose.
Especially not to you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The stage has been set. All that's left is
to get
ready for their final battle!
